name: Venglustat
sort_evidence: Venglustat is not in the book, met its primary endpoint in the LEAP2MONO Phase 3 in type 3 Gaucher disease, and was accepted by the FDA for priority review on 2026-05-28 (https://www.sanofi.com/en/media-room/press-releases/2026/2026-05-28-05-00-00-3302498), while the Fabry Phase 3s PERIDOT and CARAT missed.
